categories.main_business_segments: China Railway Construction Corporation Limited (CRCC) operates primarily in engineering contracting, planning and design consulting, investment and operation, real estate development, industrial manufacturing, material logistics, green environmental protection, industrial finance, and emerging strategic industries. The company is a leading global construction contractor and infrastructure operator with a comprehensive industry chain covering research, planning, design, construction, supervision, operation, maintenance, and financing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CRCC employs advanced technologies in high-altitude railways, high-speed railways, highways, bridges, tunnels, and urban rail transit engineering design and construction. It has developed proprietary technologies such as the world's largest diameter shield tunneling machine 'Jianghai' and the first 'Taihang' beam replacement machine. The company emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, green and low-carbon technologies, and has established a '1+9+N' technology innovation system including multiple research institutes and national innovation platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves government entities, infrastructure developers, and industrial clients across sectors including transportation infrastructure (railways, highways, urban transit), real estate, industrial manufacturing, and environmental projects. Its markets span domestic China and 148 countries and regions globally, with significant projects in Asia, Africa, Europe, Latin America, and Oceania.
categories.geographic_coverage: CRCC operates extensively within China and internationally across 148 countries and regions. Its overseas business has grown, with overseas new contract value reaching 311.978 billion RMB in 2024, representing 10.27% of total new contracts. Key overseas regions include Africa, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania.
categories.supply_chain_position: CRCC functions as an integrated construction and infrastructure group with a full industry chain from upstream research and design to midstream construction and manufacturing, and downstream operation and maintenance. It also engages in investment and financing activities, positioning itself across the entire supply chain in construction and infrastructure sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-quality development guided by the '1256' mid-to-long-term strategy, emphasizing becoming a world-class modern enterprise. It prioritizes upgrading traditional construction industries and cultivating strategic emerging industries along five new tracks: new infrastructure, new equipment, new materials, new energy, and new services. R&D efforts focus on digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, green technologies, underground space utilization, and high-end equipment manufacturing, supported by a robust innovation ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: CRCC generates revenue primarily through engineering contracting services, planning and design consulting fees, sales of manufactured industrial equipment, real estate development sales, logistics services, and financial services. Revenue recognition is based on contract progress for construction and consulting, and on transfer of control for product sales and real estate.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CRCC is one of the largest and most competitive construction and infrastructure groups globally, ranked 43rd in the 2024 Fortune Global 500. It holds leading positions in high-speed rail, high-altitude rail, urban transit, and large-scale infrastructure projects, competing with other major Chinese and international construction conglomerates.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CRCC reported operating revenue of approximately 1.067 trillion RMB, a 6.22% decrease from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 22.215 billion RMB, down 14.87%. Total assets reached 1.863 trillion RMB, up 12.02%, with equity totaling 422.6 billion RMB. The company maintains a large scale with steady growth and strong contract backlog exceeding 4.28 trillion RMB.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CRCC offers comprehensive one-stop integrated services across the entire construction and infrastructure value chain, leveraging its complete industry chain and strong technological innovation capabilities. It differentiates itself through advanced engineering technologies, extensive global project experience, strong government and market relationships, and a commitment to high-quality, green, intelligent, and digital transformation to meet evolving market demands.
